m: मन्व्-आदि N. of partic. Tithis (which are anniversaries of the 14 Manus), Inscr.
मन्व्—ईश prob. w.r. for मनीषा (= ˚षया), ŚvetUp. iii, 13.
मन्व्—अन्तरा f. N. of various festivals (of the 10th day of the light half of the month Āṣāḍha, of the 8th in the dark half of the same month, and of the 3rd in the light half of Bhādra), Col.

s: klI, (manorantaramasminniti .) divyAnAM yugAnAmekasaptatiH । ityamaraH । 1 । 4 । 22 ॥ devamAnenEkasaptatiyugAni manvantaramucyate manorantaramavakASo'vaDirvA asminniti manvantaram । “evaM caturyugAKyAnAM sADikA hyekasaptatiH । kftatretAdiyuktAnAM manorantaramucyate ॥” iti liNgapurARam ॥ manavaH svAyamBuvAdayastezAmantaramavakASo'vaDirvA manvantaramiti vA । ekasaptatiriti yadyapi gaRanayA ardDayugenADikA । “dEvikAnAM yugAnAntu sahasraM brahmaRo dinam । manvantaraM taTEvEkaM tasya BAgAScaturddaSa ॥” tatkiYcidaDikA divyayugAnAmekasaptatiriti nAmaviDAne sarvvajYanArAyaRenoktatvAt taTApi alpatvAdiha noktam । manvantarasya saMKyAtavarzARi yaTA, -- “triMSatkowyastu varzARAM mAnuzeRa dvijottamAH । saptazazwistaTAnyAni niyutAnyaDikAni tu ॥ viMSatistu sahasrARi kAlo yaH sADikAM vinA । manvantarasya saMKyEzA liNge'smin kaTitA dvijAH ॥” etadaNkA yaTA, 306,720,000 । evaM caturdaSamanvantarErbrahmadinam । yugAni yaTA lENge । “pUrvvaM kftayugaM nAma tatastretA viDIyate । dvAparaSca kaliScEva yugAnyetAni suvratAH ॥” yugamAnAni yaTA, -- “catvAri trIRi dve cEkaM kftAdizu yaTAkramam । divyAbdAnAM sahasrARi yugezvAhuH purAvidaH ॥” iti ॥ anyatra ca । “catvAryyAhuH sahasrARi varzARAntu kftaM yugam । tasya tAvat satI sanDyA sanDyAMSaSca taTAviDaH ॥ itarezu sasanDyezu sasanDyAMSezu ca trizu । ekApAyena varttante sahasrARi SatAni ca ॥” iti ॥ asyArTaH । devamAne satyasya varzARi 4000 catuHsahasrARi sanDyAvarzARi 400 catvAri SatAni sanDyAMSavarzARi 400 catvAri SatAni । evaM devamAne satyasya varzARi azwaSatADikacatuHsahasrARi 4800 evaM tretAyAH zawSatADikatrisahasraM 3600 evaM dvAparasya catuHSatADikaM dvisahasram 2400 evaM kaleH SatadvayADikamekasahasram 1200 samudAyena dbAdaSasahasrARi 12000 । mAnuzamAnena satyAdInAM mAnaM yaTA, jyotize । “vasvaSvimEtrA fturanDramAsA vedA rasAzwO BujavahnivedAH । etAni SUnyatrayatAqitAni yugAbdasaMKyAH parikIrttitAni ॥” etadaNkErdfSyate satyasya yaTA, 1,728,000 । tretAyA yaTA, 1, 296, 000 । dvAparasya yaTA, 864,000 । kaleryaTA, 432,000 । samudAyena 4,320,000 । aparaM brAhmavarzAdimAnaM bAhulyaBiyA noktam । iti tawwIkAyAM BarataH ॥ api ca । brahmaRo dinamaDye caturddaSamanvantarARi Bavanti । eko manuryAvadaDikArI Bavati sa kAlo manvantarasaMjYako Bavati । tatra manUnAM nAmAni । praTamaH svAyamBuvo manuH । dvitIyaH svArocizo manuH । tftIya uttamo manuH । caturTastAmaso manuH । paYcamo rEvato manuH । zazWaScAkzuzo manuH । saptamo vEvasvato manuH । varttamAno'yam ॥ azwamaH sAvarRirmanuH । navamo dakzasAvarRirmanuH । daSamo brahmasAvarRirmanuH । ekAdaSo DarmmasAvarRirmanuH । dvAdaSo rudrasAvarRirmanuH । trayodaSo yamAdayo devAH । marIcipraBftayaH saptarzayaH । svAyamBuvo manuH । priyavratottAnapAdO manuputtrO ॥ 1 ॥ svArocize viBuravatAraH । rocana indraH । devAstuzitAdayaH । UrjjastamBAdayaH saptarzayaH । agnisutaH svArocizo manuH । dyumatsenarocizmatpramuKA manuputtrAH ॥ 2 ॥ uttame satyaseno'vatAraH । satyajidindraH । satyavedaSrutaBadrAdayo devAH । vaSizWasutAH saptarzayaH pramadAdayaH । dakzasAvarRirmanuH । BUtaketudIptiketvAdyAstatsutAH ॥ 9 ॥ brahmasAvarRike vivvakseno'vatAraH । SamBurindraH । surasenavirudDAdyA devAH । havizmadAdyAH saptarzayaH । brahmasAvarRirmanuH । BUrisenAdyAstatsutAH ॥ 10 ॥ DarmmasAvarRike DarmmaseturavatAraH । vEDfta indraH । vihaNgamakAmagamAdyA devAH । aruRAdayaH saptarzayaH । DarmmasAvarRirmanuH । satyaDarmmAdayastatsutAH ॥ 11 ॥ rudrasAvarRike । suDAmAKyo'vatAraH । ftaDAmA indraH । haritAdayo devAH । tapomUrttyAdayaH saptarzayaH । rudrasAvarRirmanuH । devavadupadevAdayastatsutAH ॥ 12 ॥ devasAvarRike yogeSvaro'vatAraH । divaspatirindraH । sukarmmasUtrAdyA devAH । nirmmokatattvadarSAdyAH saptarzayaH । deva sAvarRirmanuH । citrasenavicitrAdyAstatsutAH ॥ 13 ॥ indrasAvarRike bfhadBAnuravatAraH । SucirindraH । pavitracAkzuzAdayo devAH । agnibAhuSuciSudDamAgaDAdyAH saptarzayaH । indrasAvarRirmanuH । urugamBIravfDnAdyAstatsutAH ॥ 14 ॥ aTEtezAM karmmocyate । indro devarAw yaTAvarzI ca । manurAdO pfTivyAM rAjA Bavati tatputtrapOttrAdayo manvantarasamAptiparyyantaM rAjAno Bavanti । devatAH pujAnAM yajYAdikarmmatuzwAstatPalaM prayacCanti । saptarzayo DarmmaSAstrARi prakASayanti । BagavadavatArA etAn svasvakarmmaRi niyojayanti dEtyarAkzasAdIn Darmmadruho Gnanti ca । caturddaSamanvantarErbrahmaRa ekaM dinaM Bavati tanmanuzyamAnenEkaH kalpaH । triMSatkalpErbrahmaRa eko mAso Bavati । iti SrIBAgavatamatam ॥ * ॥ anyacca । “varzalakzARi catvAri Bavet kaliyugaM krame । dvAtriMSatyA sahasrEstu sahitAnyapi saMKyayA ॥ catuHzazwisahasrARi lakzARyazwO ca saMKyayA । varzARAM dvAparaM proktaM yugaM pUrvvanidarSanAt ॥ tretA dvAdaSalakzARi varzARAM parikIrttitA । zaRRavatyA sahasrEstu saMyuktAni Bavanti hi ॥ daSa sapta ca lakzARAM varzARAYca kftaM yugam । sahasrErazwaviMSatyA saMyutAnyapi saMKyayA ॥ tricatvAriMSallakzARi sahasrARi ca viMSatiH । mAnuzeRa pramARena Bavet cAturyugaM kramAt ॥ saptazazwiSca lakzARi triMSatkowyastaTEva ca । viMSatiSca sahasrARi manvantaramihocyate ॥ caturyugEkasaptatyA manvantaramiti SrutiH । kalpo manvantarEreBiScaturddaSaBirucyate ॥ kowyo dbAdaSa zawtriMSallakzARi tu Bavanti ca । azwASItisahasrARi jIvet svAyamBuvo manuH ॥” iti vahnipurARam ॥ aparaYca । mArkaRqeya uvAca । “manvantaraM manoH kAlo yAvat pAlayate prajAH । eko manuH sa kAlastu manvantaramiti Srutam ॥ tadekasaptatiyugErdevAnAmiha jAyate । tEScaturddaSaBiH kalpo dinamekantu veDasaH ॥” iti kAlikApurARe 27 aDyAyaH ॥ anyadapi । “manvantarARyaSezARi SrotumicCAmyanukramAt । manvantarADipAMScEva SakradevapurogamAn । BavatA kaTitAnetAn SrotumicCAmyahaM guro ! ॥ SrIparASara uvAca । atItAnAgatAnIha yAni manvantarARi vE । tAnyahaM BavataH samyak kaTayAmi samAsataH ॥ svAyamBuvo manuH pUrvvaM manuH svArocizastaTA । OttamistAmasaScEva rEvataScAkzuzastaTA ॥ zaqete manavo'tItAH sAmpratantu raveH sutaH । vEvasvato'yaM tasyEtat saptamaM varttate'ntaram ॥ svAyamBuvantu kaTitaM kalpAdAvantaraM mayA । devAstatrarzayaScEva yaTAvat kaTitA mayA ॥ 1 ॥ ata UrdDaM pravakzyAmi manoH svArocizasya tu । manvantarADipAn samyagdevarzI statsutAMstaTA ॥ pArAvatAH satuzitA devAH svArocize'ntare । vipaScittatra devendro mEtreyAsInmahAbalaH ॥ ojastamBastaTA prARo dattolirfzaBastaTA । viSvaraScArvvarIvAMSca tatra saptarzayo'Bavan ॥ cEtrakiMpuruzAdyASca sutAH svArocizasya tu । dvitIyametadvyAKyAtamantaraM SfRu cottamam ॥ 2 ॥ tftIye'pyantare brahmannOttamirnAma yo manuH । suSAntirnAma tatrendro mEtreyABUt sureSvaraH ॥ suDAmAnastaTA satyAH SivAScATa pratarddanAH । vaSavarttinaSca paYcEte gaRA dvAdaSakAH smftAH ॥ vaSizWatanayAstatra sapta saptarzayo'Bavan । ajaH paraSudivyAdyAstaTOttamimanoH sutAH ॥ 3 ॥ tAmasasyAntare devAH svarUpA harayastaTA । matyASca suDiyaScEva saptaviMSatikA gaRAH ॥ SivirindrastaTA cAsIcCatayajYopalakzaRaH । saptarzayaSca ye tatra tezAM nAmmani me SfRu ॥ jyotirDAmA pfTuH kAvyaScEtro'gnirvvatakastaTA । pIvaraScarzayo hyete sapta tatrApi cAntare ॥ naraH KyAtiH SAntahayo jAnujaNgAdayastaTA । puttrAstu tAmasasyAsan rAjAnaH sumahAbalAH ॥ 4 ॥ paYcame cApi mEtreya ! rEvato nAma nAmataH । manurviBuSca tatrendro devAMScEvAntare SfRu ॥ amitABA BUtarayA vENkuwASca sumeDasaH । ete devagaRAstatra caturddaSa caturddaSa ॥ hiraRyaromA vedaSrIrUrdDabAhustaTAparaH । vedabAhuH suDAmA ca parjjanyaSca mahAmuniH । ete saptarzayo vipra ! tatrAsan rEvatAntare ॥ balabanDuH susamBAvyaH satyakAmASca tatsutAH । narendrAH sumahAvIryyA baBUvurmunisattama ! ॥ svArocizaScOttamistu tAmaso rEvatastaTA । priyavratAnvayA hyete catvAro manavaH smftAH ॥ vizRumArADya tapasA sa rAjarziH priyavrataH । manvantarADipAnetAn labDavAnAtmavaMSajAn ॥ 5 ॥ zazWe manvantare cAsIccAkzuzAKyastadA manuH । manojavastaTEvendro devAnapi niboDa me ॥ AryyAH prasUtA BavyASca pfTugASca divOkasaH । mahAnuBAvA leKASca paYcEte'pyazwakA gaRAH ॥ mumeDA virajAScEva havizmAnuttamo maDuH । atinAmA sahizRuSca saptAsanniti carzayaH ॥ UruH pUruH SatadyumnapramuKAH sumahAbalAH । cAkzuzasyaM manoH puttrAH pfTivIpatayo'Bavan ॥ 6 ॥ vivasvataH suto vipra ! SrAdDadevo mahAdyutiH । manuH sa varttate DImAn sAmprataM saptame'ntare ॥ AdityavasurudrAdyA devAScAtra mahAmune ! । purandarastaTEvAtra mEtreya ! tridaSeSvaraH ॥ vaSizWaH kaSyapo'TAgnirjamadagniH sagOtamaH । viSvAmitraBaradvAjO sapta saptarzayo'tra ca ॥ ikzvAkuScEva nABAgo DfzwaH SaryAtireva ca । narizyantaSca viKyAto nABa udizwa eva ca ॥ karUzaSca pfzaDraSca vasumAn lokaviSrutaH । manorvEvasvatasyEte nava puttrAstu DArmmikAH ॥ 7 ॥ vizRuSaktiranOpamyA sattvodriktA sTitO sTitA । manvantarezvaSezezu devatvenADitizWati ॥ aMSena tasya yajYo'sO jajYe svAyamBuve'ntare । AkUtyAM mAnaso deva utpannaH praTame'ntare ॥ tataH punaH sa vE devaH prApte svArocize'ntare । tuzitAyAM samutpanno hyajitastuzitEH saha ॥ Ottamerantare cApi tuzitastu punaH sa vE । satyAyAmaBavat satyaH satyEH saha surottamEH ॥ tAmasasyAntare cEva saMprApte punareva hi । haryyAyAM hariBiH sArdDaM harireva baBUva ha ॥ rEvate'pyantare devaH samBUtyAM mAnaso'Bavat । samBUto rAjasEH sArdDaM devErdevavaro hariH ॥ cAkzuze cAntare devo vEkuRWaH puruzottamaH । vikuRWAyAmasO jajYe vEkuRWe dEvatEH saha ॥ manvantare tu saMprApte taTA vEvasvate dvijaH । vAmanaH kaSyapAdvizRuradityAM saMbaBUva ha ॥ triBiH kramErimAn lokAn jitvA yena mahAtmanA । purandarAya trElokyaM dattaM nihatakaRwakam ॥ ityetAstanavastasya saptamanvantarezu vE । saptasvevABavan vipra ! yABiH saMrakzitAH prajAH ॥ yasmAdvizwamidaM sarvvaM tasya SaktyA mahAtmanaH । tasmAt saMprocyate vizRurvviSerDAtoH praveSanAt ॥ sarvve ca devA manavaH samastAH saptarzayo ye manusUnavaSca । indraSca yo yastridaSeSaBUto vizRoraSezAstu viBUtayastAH ॥” iti vizRupurARe 3 aMSe manvantarAKyAnaM nAma 1 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ SrImEtreya uvAca । proktAnyetAni BavatA sapta manvantarARi vE । BavizyARyapi viprarze ! mamAKyAtuM tvamarhasi ॥ SrIparASara uvAca । “CAyAsaMjYAsuto yo'sO dvitIyaH kaTito manuH । pUrvvajasya savarRo'sya sAvarRistena kaTyate ॥ tasya manvantaraM hyetat sAvarRikamaTAzwamam । tacCfRuzva mahABAga ! BavizyaM kaTayAmi te ॥ sAvarRistu manuryo'sO mEtreya ! m: मन्व्—अन्तर n. the period or age of a Manu (it comprises about 71 महा-युगस् [q.v.], which are held equal to 12,000 years of the gods or 4,320,000 human years or 1/14th of a day of Brahmā ; each of these periods is presided over by its own special Manu [see मनु, p. 784, col. 2]; six such Manvantaras have already elapsed, and the 7th, presided over by Manu Vaivasvata, is now going on; 7 more are to come, making 14 Manvantaras, which together make up one day of Brahmā), Mn. (esp. i, 79), Yājñ.; MBh. &c.

k.v: मन्वन्तरं तु दिव्यानां युगानामेकसप्ततिः। संवर्तः प्रलयः कल्पः क्षयः कल्पान्त इत्यपि॥
